map.根据宠物种类、年龄和目标，制定科学的每日训练计划: Based on pet species, age and goals, create a scientific daily training plan
map.📖 查看「宠物训练计划生成器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pet Training Plan Generator User Guide"
map.1. 正向强化为主，及时奖励（零食+表扬）: 1. Primarily positive reinforcement, reward promptly (treats + praise)
map.2. 短时多次，每次10-15分钟最佳: 2. Short and frequent sessions, 10-15 minutes each is optimal
map.3. 保持耐心，不打骂体罚: 3. Stay patient, no scolding or physical punishment
map.4. 难度循序渐进，不要跳级: 4. Progress gradually in difficulty, do not skip levels
map.5. 训练前先适当运动消耗精力: 5. Exercise appropriately before training to burn off energy
map.6. 在宠物状态好时训练: 6. Train when the pet is in a good state
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考。每只宠物性格不同，请根据实际情况调整训练节奏。如有行为问题: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only. Every pet has a different personality; please adjust the training pace to the actual situation. For behavioral problems, consult a professional dog/cat trainer.
map.📚 深度解析：宠物训练计划生成器: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Pet Training Plan Generator
map.按宠物种类、年龄阶段与选定训练目标，自动生成一周训练课表（天数/每次时长/项目数: Based on pet species, age stage and selected training goals, automatically generate a one-week training schedule (days / duration per session / number of items).
map.把多个目标（如定点排泄、随行、召回）拆成每日任务，循序渐进、避免一次灌输过多。: Break multiple goals (e.g. housebreaking, heel, recall) into daily tasks, progressing step by step and avoiding overloading at once.
map.训导员按计划打卡（勾选完成），直观跟踪每周训练覆盖度。: Trainers check in per the plan (check to complete), intuitively tracking weekly training coverage.
map.选择 2 个训练目标、每日 20 分钟：工具输出 7 天周期概览（7 天 / 2: Select 2 training goals, 20 minutes per day: the tool outputs a 7-day cycle overview (7 days / 20 minutes·day / several training sessions / several training items), and rotates the tasks across daily time slots, showing the specific training action and its goal each day.
map.按当前宠物种类取对应目标库，把选中目标的任务合并后，按“每日时段表”轮转分配到周: Take the corresponding goal library by current pet species, merge the tasks of selected goals, then rotate-assign them to Monday through Sunday by the 'daily time-slot table'; the overview card shows the number of days, daily minutes, training sessions and total items.
map.能指定某天练某个动作吗？: Can I specify a certain day to practice a certain action?
map.当前为自动轮转排布；如需固定某天内容，可在生成后手动调整顺序。计划是训练框架，实: Currently it is auto-rotated; if you need to fix a certain day's content, you can manually adjust the order after generation. The plan is a training framework; actual progress should be flexibly advanced by combining the pet's state with positive reinforcement.
